scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @overload/server" "npm run dev -w @overload/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @overload/shared && npm run build -w @overload/server && npm run build -w @overload/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @overload/server && npm run test:unit -w @overload/web -- --run
